Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Action-routed UI switchboard for the repointed IncomingOrders layouts (193/220/221, anchors ORD__ORDERS / ORD__OrderLines). Every button and trigger binds here with an "action" param. Owns ONLY front-end concerns — dialogs, popovers, navigation, portal refresh, found sets. All data work delegates to headless workers.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: PARAMS (JSON): action (required) + per-action keys. trigger=1 on every trigger binding — exits with True instead of the envelope so OnObjectSave/Validate/Keystroke events are never cancelled by a JSON result. skipDialog=1 suppresses all dialogs (harness / headless runs). Record-bound verbs accept explicit IDs and fall back to the current record / portal row. VERBS: init — OnLayoutEnter 193/220: phone layouts show toolbars (fold of ORD__phoneLayoutEnter 647) load — Show All Records + Go to Record [Last] (found-set refresh; matches Init_IncomingOrders 627) scan — fold of Scan Button 585: DocumentScan present -> New Record; delegates to Scan Ulazna Faktura (584) addArticle — sifra (param | Globals::SifraProizvoda | barcode when scan=1) -> ORD__AddArticle (960); create mode: primkaID (default current record), assign mode: stavkaID; kolicina optional newItem — ORD__NewItem (962) on primkaID (default current); from IncomingOrders_phone navigates to the new line (StavkePrimke_phone + Go to Record) deleteItem — confirm dialog, then ORD__DeleteOrderItem (963) on stavkaID (default portal row); guard violations shown in one dialog priceNabavnaStart / priceProdajnaStart — popover open: $$nabavnaPokazi/$$prodajnaPokazi, seed *Total_Global from *Total_Calculation, Go to Field (fold of 615/617) priceNabavnaEnd / priceProdajnaEnd — ORD__SetLinePrices (964, basis=total) from amount (default *Total_Global); stavkaID default $$*Pokazi then portal row; empty amount = cancel, no write (fold of 616/618). Double-fire safe (Save+Validate bindings). addVAT — keystroke fold of ORD__AddVATtoPrice (926): Ctrl-Shift-Plus multiplies the active price field by 117/100 in the UI layer (programmatic path: 964 addVAT param) receiptTemplate — ORD__FillReceiptTemplate (965) on primkaID (default current); bind to supplier popup OnObjectExit on 193 goToSupplier — Navigation_ "suppliers|<supplierID>" (default current record FK; replaces ORD__GoToSupplier 619) transferToSO — availability check via epSQL, clears Globals::ServiceOrderSelector (legacy picker state dropped), opens SO picker (SO__OpenSOPicker 815); the picker header path returns via SO__PickerConfirm (813) -> transferToSOConfirm transferToSOConfirm — INTERNAL, called by SO__PickerConfirm (813): rebuilds available stavkePKs for the current primka, delegates SO__AttachPrimke (809), success dialog + optional Navigation_ "orders|<serviceOrderID>" (replaces CopyToOrder 620 confirm) DROPPED VERBS (Stage-3 decisions): syncLedger — retired KR workflow; the S__UFLine__SyncSnapshotsToLedger (659) OnObjectSave triggers on 193 are removed, not rebound. partPickerInit / selectForReturn / setSpecificPart — host layout StavkePrimkePicker (201) was deleted; scripts 662/543/609 are orphaned and go to Stage-5 retirement. RETURNS: Response_Finalize envelope (worker envelopes absorbed); trigger=1 returns True. CONTEXT: layouts anchored on ORD__ORDERS (193/220/251) or ORD__OrderLines (194/221). Headless runs must pass explicit IDs. Example button binding Perform Script [ Specified: From list ; "ORD__OrdersDispatcher" ; Parameter: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; "action" ; "scan" ; JSONString ) ]
